name: Blood Pact grants 50 dodge and its conditional healing clause (#3245)
contract: Blood Pact 801955 ships three SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA effects in Spell.dbc. Effect 0 is aura 185 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_RANGED_HIT_CHANCE with BasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50, live in Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst. Effect 2 is aura 49 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DODGE_PERCENT with BasePoints 49 + DieSides 1 = +50 (AuraEffect::HandleAuraModDodgePercent). Effect 1 is aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT with BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, which is the description's conditional $?s560257[...] clause: Blood Runs Cold 560257 is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 3 = SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20 and SpellClassMask (0, 0, 65536), which matches Blood Pact's own SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 65536), so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue raises effect 1 to 20% once it is learned. Both halves are native. NOT covered here: the description's closing sentence "While active you can dodge or parry while casting." Unit::CanDefendDuringCast() (CLASS_SON_OF_ARUGAL/Bloodmage with aura 801955) now gates the generic-cast branch at the same 4 dodge/parry call sites that previously zeroed dodge/parry unconditionally outside Unit::CanDefendDuringChannel's own Demon Hunter exemption; every other victim is unaffected since skipGeneric defaults to false everywhere else. The harness has no per-swing combat-log outcome metric (apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md), and an attempted statistical scenario built from melee_attack_count/melee_damage_count over repeated generic casts did not land a reliably discriminating threshold in this session (observed landed-swing rates were far higher than a +50 dodge chance would predict, which may mean most swings fell in the idle gaps between casts rather than mid-cast, or that the chosen metrics do not isolate the clause as cleanly as assumed); that attempt was discarded rather than committed as a weak test. This clause is still left to a Ghost e2e combat-log test, or a future gameplay-test metric that reads the actual dodge/parry outcome per swing. 801955 is not passive (Attributes 0x0), so WorldSession::HandleCastSpellOpcode (SpellHandler.cpp:460) discards the cast unless the caster holds the spell (HasActiveSpell); the scenario learns it first. Learning it does not disturb the two spell_effect_value assertions above, which read SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue and submit nothing.

steps.label: The healing clause is 0 until Blood Runs Cold is learned
Blood Runs Cold raises it to the shipped 20%
Know the pact before casting it
Blood Pact is active on its caster
Dodge chance rises by 50 percentage points
The ranged-hit penalty carries the shipped -50
